summary: The Ash Twin Project is a Nomai facility hidden inside the core of Ash Twin, powered by an Advanced Warp Core. It is the source of the 22-minute time loop: when the Sun goes supernova, the project sends the linked creatures' memories and the probe's coordinates 22 minutes into the past via a generated black hole.

location: The Ash Twin Project is located within the core of Ash Twin, one of the Hourglass Twins.
The Ash Twin Project is encased in a large spherical shell that completely seals off the central chamber.
The spherical shell has no physical entrances; the only route in is via warp.
The Ash Twin Project itself is a large ring-shaped platform circling a central Advanced Warp Core.
Along the ring are Nomai research notes, artwork, and multiple Projection Stones.
At the ring's center is a small open room with a console and eight Nomai Masks surrounding it.
Three of the eight Nomai Masks are active during the player's loop; the other five remain inactive.
At the end of the ring are two sphere consoles: one stops the platform's rotation (disabling artificial gravity); the other opens the casing around the Advanced Warp Core to allow its removal.
A northern array on the surface of Ash Twin powers the Ash Twin Project during the supernova event.
The Ash Twin Project is reached via one specific teleportation tower on Ash Twin — the broken one of the two paired towers connected by a bridge.
Outside the warp tower leading to the Ash Twin Project lies the corpse of a Nomai.
During the Self ending, the player character themselves becomes the inhabitant of the Ash Twin Project.
lore: The Ash Twin Project is a facility built by the Nomai.
The Ash Twin Project was designed by the Nomai to harness the energy of a supernova to send data 22 minutes into the past.
The purpose of the Ash Twin Project was to make locating the Eye of the Universe faster by allowing the Orbital Probe Cannon to retain probe-launch data across resets.
Yarrow led the excavation of the Ash Twin core where the facility was built.
Coleus and Ramie relocated subterranean plants encountered during the excavation.
Poke crafted the Advanced Warp Core for the Ash Twin Project at the Black Hole Forge.
Clary and Root assisted in crafting the Advanced Warp Core at the Black Hole Forge.
Cassava and Avens crafted the Orbital Probe Cannon on Giant's Deep.
Phlox and Daz sculpted the memory statues.
Pye and Idaea designed and built the Sun Station to artificially trigger the Sun's supernova.
Ramie installed the Nomai Masks inside the Ash Twin Project.
Oeno helped Yarrow and Ramie check the spherical shell for cracks during the final safety inspection.
When the Nomai first activated the Sun Station, it failed to induce a supernova; the Ash Twin Project could not be powered.
The Nomai paused their supernova research to investigate the newly arrived Interloper comet.
Shortly after, Ghost Matter erupted from the Interloper's core and killed every Nomai in the solar system.
The Nomai never saw the Ash Twin Project function during their lifetimes.
Hundreds of thousands of years after the Nomai's death, the Sun reaches the end of its lifespan and goes supernova naturally, finally triggering the Ash Twin Project.
After many loops with only the Orbital Probe Cannon active, the probe locates the Eye of the Universe, prompting the other Nomai Statues to activate.
The Timber Hearth statue activated and synced with the Protagonist because the Protagonist was the closest creature to it at that moment.
mechanics: The Ash Twin Project is powered by an Advanced Warp Core whose design is based on the one used by The Vessel.
The Advanced Warp Core can be physically removed from the project.
Removing the Advanced Warp Core shuts down the Ash Twin Project and ends the 22-minute time loop until the core is reinserted.
If the player dies while the Advanced Warp Core is removed, the game ends and returns the player to the main menu.
The Advanced Warp Core is required for the intended ending of the game.
Each time loop created by the Ash Twin Project lasts precisely 22 minutes.
The Ash Twin Project has two major components: the Nomai Masks and the Nomai Statues.
Each Nomai Statue, when activated, links with the closest living creature, then continuously transmits that creature's memories to its paired mask.
One mask is linked not to a creature but to the Orbital Probe Cannon's Tracking Module, receiving probe coordinates instead of memories.
Upon supernova activation, the Ash Twin Project generates a black hole in the center of the ring and transmits all stored mask data into it.
Stored memories and coordinates are sent backward in time through warp technology to the linked creature or module, placing them in a perceived 22-minute time loop.
Initially only the Cannon's statue is active; the other statues activate either when the Eye is located or as a fail-safe if equipment fails.
The fail-safe activation of statues was added by Phlox so the Nomai would remain aware of any malfunctions.
The platform spins rapidly around the core to produce rotational artificial gravity, preventing the player from falling off.
The Ash Twin Project depends on the Sun Station triggering a supernova to provide its activation energy.
The Ash Twin warp tower leading to the project only becomes traversable when Ember Twin is directly above and the tower is uncovered by Ash Twin's sand.
